technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring Cloud Data Flow 2.x and Spring Cloud Stream 3.x (compatible with Spring Framework 6.0 and Java 17+).
Deployment properties with {{count}} placeholder will be processed by Spring Cloud Deployer at deployment time, substituting the instance count for each module.
GitHub Pages (gh_pages branch) will be used for documentation hosting; documentation build will use Jekyll (default GitHub Pages) with AsciiDoc/Markdown sources.
Kafka binder fix will address connection pooling and serialization issues in spring-cloud-stream-binder-kafka, ensuring compatibility with Kafka 3.x clients.
Reference documentation will be written in AsciiDoc and published to the Spring Cloud Data Flow reference guide, with clear version-specific sections for 1.x and 2.x.
Concourse CI evaluation will be a spike (proof-of-concept) only; no production pipeline implementation is included in this increment.
RxJava processor module will implement Spring Cloud Stream's Processor interface using RxJava 3.x (Flowable) for reactive stream processing.
Banner will be a static ASCII art generated via patorjk.com, integrated via Spring Boot's banner.txt mechanism in the Spring Shell server module.
Cloud Foundry deployment documentation will follow the existing README structure and use cf CLI commands for deployment steps.
assumptions: Developer has existing knowledge of Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring Boot.
Source repositories (spring-cloud-dataflow, spring-cloud-stream-modules) are accessible and buildable with Maven/Gradle.
A Kafka broker (version 3.x) is available for integration testing of the Kafka binder fix.
Documentation is authored in AsciiDoc and built with Asciidoctor/Jekyll for GitHub Pages.
The {{count}} placeholder is the only templating feature required; no other dynamic property substitution is needed.
gh_pages branch setup includes enabling GitHub Pages in repository settings and configuring a CI job to publish the built site.
Concourse CI study is time-boxed to a spike; no decision on adoption is required within this increment.
RxJava 3.x is the target version; Spring Cloud Stream's reactive API aligns with Reactive Streams specification.
Shell server is a Spring Boot application using Spring Shell; banner integration uses standard Spring Boot banner location (src/main/resources/banner.txt).
Cloud Foundry deployment steps are based on the current cf CLI v7+ and Spring Cloud Data Flow server for Cloud Foundry.
Code reviews are conducted by the same developer (self-review) or via pull requests; effort includes review time.
Development environment (JDK 17, Maven, Git, Docker for Kafka) is already configured.
